$comment: Consumed by scripts/docs/public_ux.py (DOC-PUBLIC-UX-001, docs/development/PUBLIC_DOCS_UX.md). The human/public documentation layer. Everything not listed here is internal and is not checked by this gate. Owner direction 2026-09-26: the public surface carries no architect/developer documents, so Architecture and Development Guide are deliberately absent until the owner confirms them.
$enforce: false = REPORT-ONLY: findings are printed as NOTE lines and the gate exits 0. Flipping this to true at milestone DOC-PUBLIC-01 is the single reviewed change that turns every finding into a failure.

readme_sections.$why: The README reader test: each question must have a heading that answers it. A heading matches when it contains any of the keywords (case-insensitive).

product_id_prefixes.$why: Artifact names an operator meets in the product itself (snapshot, evaluation and acceptance files). They are product vocabulary, not internal process identifiers.
